title: Strait of Gibraltar
html:
Not to be confused with Gateway to the Atlantic

Strait of Gibraltar is a map with a canal in the middle (naturally-made).

This map can be seen as a zoomed in version of Gateway to the Atlantic.

[[|thumb|A map of Strait of Gibraltar.]]

Nations

The map features 16 named nations, including Algeria, Portugal, Shilha, Huelva, Cadiz and Malaga.

Map data

  • Categories: Europe, Africa

  • Public rotation frequency: 5
